assumptions.model: PMMA core / V shell / air, triangular lattice, PMMA substrate

metal.interpolation: linear epsilon in wavelength_nm; epsilon=(n+i*k)^2; no extrapolation

assumptions.convergence_rule: last two refinements on every axis, physical powers, stable fixed configuration v1

spectrum_statistics.weighting: uniform wavelength; no solar or source weighting

integration.host_preparation: geometry, material interpolation and quadrature setup on CPU
integration.gpu_calculation: complex128 matrices, eigenproblems, interfaces, cascade and flux

interpretation: A=1-R-T; lossless PMMA; absorption occurs in patterned V and valley coating; no metal substrate.
limitations: Convergence is checked at anchor wavelengths only; R+T+A=1 is an algebraic identity, not an independent absorption-volume check. Ideal radial shell and flat cap approximate deposition.
